t: Carlube LM2 multi-purpose grease is a lithium-based lubricant designed for reliable performance across various applications. Features a high melting point, which offers excellent low-temperature fluidity and robust high-temperature performance, ideal for automotive components, industrial machinery, and general workshop use. Provides high quality anti-wear and corrosion protection, ensuring extended component life and smooth operation. The grease is effective from 0°C up to 150°C, delivering consistent lubrication for demanding trade tasks. Supplied in a convenient cartridge,
